data.why: The repo bundles demo/treino_demo.db plus demo/treino/*.json+*.png diagnostic figures built for its public Streamlit Community Cloud demo, so the visual-review quiz runs fully offline with no files to add.

goals: Decide, from the phase-folded light curve alone, whether a candidate TESS signal has a clean repeating shape or is just noise
Use the per-pixel amplitude map to judge whether the signal truly comes from the target star or leaks from a brighter neighbor
Classify each case as confirm, doubt, or discard, and track calibration accuracy (overall, last 20, and per true-answer bias) over a session
Choose whether the true orbital period is P or 2P by comparing the curve folded at each, to distinguish an eclipsing binary from a pulsator or rotator
Recognize TESS systematic periods (1 d, 13.7 d, 6.85 d, 4.57 d) and other failure modes (too few cycles, weak amplitude, variable neighbor) that should drive a discard

review.summary: The tree accurately captures Vagalume's Treino mode: judge the folded curve and pixel map, decide confirm/doubt/discard, answer P vs 2P, and watch calibration by true class. Every one of the 11 screens I opened supports its node. It needs small fixes before filing: case numbers that change per session, a misstated P/2P trigger, some duplicate actions, and a missing folded-curve feature.
